mapper.select:
select cp.id, cp.create_time, cp.update_time, cp.name, cp.description, cp.type, cp.amount, cp.discount, cp.min_amount, cp.use_range, cp.target_id, cp.is_support_group_buy, cp.begin_time, cp.end_time, cp.is_used, cp.used_time from s_member_coupon cp where cp.deleted = 0 and cp.member_id = #{userId}
and cp.is_used = 0 and now() between cp.begin_time and cp.end_time
and cp.is_used = 1
and cp.is_used = 0 and now() > cp.end_time
order by cp.create_time desc

select cp.id, cp.create_time as createTime, cp.coupon_id as couponId, cp.name as couponName, cp.type as couponType, case when cp.type = 2 then cp.discount * 10 else cp.amount end as couponValue, cp.min_amount as minAmount, coalesce(member.nickname, member.account) as memberName, `order`.order_no as orderNo, `order`.total_amount as orderAmount, ifnull(`order`.discount_amount, 0) as discountAmount, cp.used_time as useTime, case when cp.is_used = 1 then 1 when now() > cp.end_time then 2 else 0 end as status from s_member_coupon cp left join s_member member on member.id = cp.member_id and member.deleted = 0 left join s_order_coupon order_coupon on order_coupon.member_coupon_id = cp.id and order_coupon.deleted = 0 left join s_order `order` on `order`.id = order_coupon.order_id and `order`.deleted = 0 where cp.deleted = 0 and cp.mch_id = #{mchId} and cp.shop_id = #{shopId}
and cp.coupon_id = #{query.couponId}
and (member.nickname like concat('%', #{query.memberKeyword}, '%') or member.account like concat('%', #{query.memberKeyword}, '%') or member.mobile like concat('%', #{query.memberKeyword}, '%'))
and cp.is_used = 0 and now() <= cp.end_time
and cp.is_used = 1
and cp.is_used = 0 and now() > cp.end_time
order by cp.used_time desc, cp.create_time desc
